verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents standard OAuth 2.0 flows as built-in capabilities: the Client Credentials flow, the Device Authorization flow, and securing APIs with OAuth 2.0. It also offers hosted Universal Login and per-application-type quickstarts, so developers avoid hand-rolling the protocol. Community users back this up, reporting a 2-day integration and roughly a hundred hours saved. However, the two flows the story names are not shown in the evidence; the Token Vault refresh handling covers third-party API tokens, not the app's own refresh tokens. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the authorization code flow with PKCE, first-party refresh token issuance/rotation, OIDC ID token handling, and hands-on corroboration of those specific flows.
